name: Concurso Nacional de Acesso
localName: Concurso Nacional de Acesso ao Ensino Superior Público

coverage.includes: Degrees at public universities and polytechnics.
coverage.excludes: Private institutions such as Universidade Católica Portuguesa, which admit directly, and CTeSP short-cycle courses.

choiceRules.note: Several degree-and-institution pairs, ranked. The limit was not re-read for this record.

decisionModel: Ranking only. Each degree has fixed places; applicants are ranked on their secondary grade and entrance-exam results on a 0–200 scale, weighted as the institution sets.
replyModel: Three phases, July to October. A placement must be taken up by enrolling within a few days.
